        // Extended Euclidean algorithm
        long t = 0, newt = 1;
        long r = MOD, newr = a;

            long q = r / newr;
            long temp = t - q * newt;
            t = newt;
            newt = temp;
            temp = r - q * newr;
            r = newr;
            newr = temp;

        if (r > 1) throw new ArithmeticException("Not invertible");
        if (t < 0) t += MOD;
        return t;
    }

    static long modPow(long a, long e) {
        long res = 1;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) res = res * a % MOD;
            a = a * a % MOD;
